items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: In fact you and Stan Kenton and a couple of other people really were on the ground floor of jazz education.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was in the time I was playing alto.
Well you have been in both worlds, the performing jazz world and the jazz education. In fact you and Stan Kenton and a couple of other people really were on the ground floor of jazz education.
Are you speaking about the Summer Jazz Camps?
